meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把目标拆解成有依据的步骤并循环推进
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望按步骤推进目标并留有证据
copy.tagline_en: Break down goals into evidence-bound steps and loop them
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want step-by-step goal tracking with evidence.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你的目标拆成一个个可验证的小步骤,逐步执行并用真实输出记录证据;整个过程通过专用命令行工具管理进度,支持手动检查,还会按规则委派子代理处理代码任务。
howto.when: 当你说出「ulw-loop」「ulw」等关键词,或要求进行持久目标执行等长期任务时,Claude 会进入该流程。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把『搭建个人网站』拆成带检查点的步骤并执行。
say.note: Claude 会先读取流程文档,再分解步骤并逐步验证。

say.text: 启动 ulw-loop,每一步都要求手动 QA 并记录证据。
say.note: 它会按证据规则记录每个成功标准。

say.text: 用 ulw 模式完成这个数据分析任务,输出带证据的结论。
say.note: 涉及代码时,会委派子代理执行并核对结果。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude breaks your goal into small verifiable steps, executes them, and records evidence from real outputs; it manages progress via a CLI tool, supports manual QA, and delegates code work to subagents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "ulw-loop" or "ulw", or ask for durable goal execution and similar long-running tasks.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to break 'build a personal site' into checkpointed steps and run it.
say_en.note: Claude reads the workflow doc first, then decomposes and verifies.

say_en.text: Start ulw-loop, require manual QA and evidence recording for each step.
say_en.note: It records each success criterion with evidence.

say_en.text: Use ulw mode for this data analysis task and deliver conclusions with evidence.
say_en.note: Code tasks are delegated to subagents and checked.
